notes: §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR1: 'The first line number on which a body group can be presented is the line number specified by the FIRST DETAIL phrase'. For 1985 source this holds: GroupLimits' BodyUpper returns FIRST DETAIL when no CONTROL HEADING carries OR PAGE, ScreenReportGroupLines refuses (COBOL2199) a DE, CH, CF or LINE n NEXT PAGE line above it, and FirstLineTarget puts a relative first body group on a page at FIRST DETAIL (witness: PAGE 2 LINE 06 with FD 6). Missing part: the 2002 OR PAGE phrase is not refused at --std 85 (no construct row, no VersionConformancePass arm) and then moves the body upper limit off FIRST DETAIL by the 2023 §2023:13.18.57.4 GR7 d) rule, so at 85 a detail LINE 5 with FIRST DETAIL 5 is refused as 'above the upper limit 6'. Probes: b1-b4 refused, b6/b7 placed at FD after PH and after page advance, b5 (CH K OR PAGE) compiled and reprinted CHK at FD on page 2, b5b refused. kb/Work PB5242 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-51.json).

next.reason: 1985: 'The first line number on which a body group can be presented is the line number specified by the FIRST DETAIL phrase'. 2023 keeps it only conditionally: §2023:13.18.57.4 GR7 c) 'The upper limit for a body group, if there is no control heading defined in the report with the OR PAGE phrase, is the line given by the FIRST DETAIL integer', and adds d) 'If there is at least one control heading defined in the report with the OR PAGE phrase, the upper limit for a body group is determined as follows' (a lower control heading's limit follows the higher one). OR PAGE is accepted by 2023, refused by 1985: a case added.
